name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog: * A site pulled onto a computer with a full-site pull is marked as a copy. On it, WordPress's scheduled jobs stay off and an admin notice says so, so the copy can't run the live site's queued posts and sends a second time.
